column3: From the mind is not expressed separately.
“It will not come” supplies the missing main clause.
“Will continue” supplies a predicate; becoming out of the midst is rendered passively as “is taken out of the way.”
“Of the lawless one” specifies whose; the present coming is is rendered “will be accompanied.”
BSB’s “will send” matches the future of the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the present (πέμπει).
BSB’s “from the beginning” follows the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “as firstfruits” (ἀπαρχὴν).
BSB’s “you” as a second object matches the Textus Receptus (ὑμᾶς); work and word are reversed.
